get.description: Privacy-safe administrative audit feed. Only explicitly allowlisted admin/auth actions with no patient subject are visible. Unknown and clinical actions are excluded. Actor is an ID, never an email/name; target is only a bounded administrative ID extracted for known admin/device actions. No clinical text, patient IDs, detail JSON, lookup queries, changed field values or credentials. Outcome is derived from the allowlisted event action, not arbitrary detail. Clinic-limited admins see only their clinic and cannot request another clinic; network admins may filter across clinics. Null-clinic events are visible only to network admins. Descending event ID keyset pagination: pass nextBeforeId as beforeId, keeping all filters fixed. New higher-ID events do not shift subsequent pages; this is not a frozen cross-request snapshot. No total count. No-store response. Existing doctor-only /audit is unchanged.

parameters.name: beforeId
parameters.description: Exclusive event ID boundary returned as nextBeforeId.

parameters.name: clinicId
parameters.description: Exact event clinic, constrained by administrator scope.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive event time, ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone; must precede to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive event time, ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone.

400.description: Invalid, unsupported or repeated query parameter, invalid range or action

401.description: Missing, expired, revoked or disabled administrator session
